target.name: Heat distribution, hydronic radiant floor heating, 150m2

strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: Tab. 5.3 'Eingabedaten des Moduls "Wärmeverteilung, Fussbodenheizung, 150 m2"', per 1 Stk; allocation: none stated. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

gaps_reported_by_model: No construction energy (electricity or diesel) for laying the floor heating is listed - Tab. 5.2 has 'Diesel in Baumaschine' but that is the borehole heat exchanger, a different module.
No infrastructure of the producing plants.
The lifetime (20 a, section 5.2.3) is given but this dataset is the whole system per unit, so no amortisation is applied here.
skipped_items: Transport LKW 28 t: no dataset chosen (No lorry FREIGHT service is offered: the candidates are the disposal and the maintenance of a 28 t lorry in units and vehicle-kilometre operation datasets, none of which is a ton-kilometre transport.)
